title: How quantum computers will break all encryption by 2030

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know your online security could vanish in a decade?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Hackers could crack your passwords in minutes by 2030.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Quantum computers use qubits to break encryption faster than any supercomputer.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They’ll target RSA-2048, the encryption used by banks and governments.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This could expose private data, crash financial systems, and compromise national security.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? We need quantum-safe encryption now, not later.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Follow me for the latest on how tech is reshaping our world.

caption_text: How quantum computers will break all encryption by 2030
